eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Morgan, UT; at 8:58 AM on AUG 9, 2026 Effective until 8:58 AM AUG 10, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Morgan County Alert: 9:50 am Hwy 66 from White's Crossing toward Tifie Ranch is in "Ready" status for possible evacuation. Be prepared to evacuate. Do not call 911. Stay alert and watch local news and cell phone alerts. Pack an emergency kit with medications, documents, water, and supplies. Make a plan and share it with your family and loved ones. Ready your household and pets, and prepare your vehicle to leave quickly. Leave early if you need extra time.
